# Paramind

> Paramind is a learning app for UK paramedics, student paramedics, newly qualified paramedics (NQPs) and ambulance technicians. It offers patient scenarios from dispatch to handover, a cardiac arrest simulator, ECG practice, interview preparation, OSCE practice, ATMIST handover practice and CPD certificates for HCPC portfolios. It runs on the web (paramind.co.uk) and as apps for iPhone and Android. Paramind is an educational tool only and is not for real patient care decisions.

Paramind is built by paramedics, for paramedics. Its tutor, Hollie, explains anatomy, physiology, pathophysiology and paramedicine topics in a friendly, conversational way, adapted to the learner's level. Content is focused on UK pre-hospital care, and Paramind maps its content to the HCPC Standards of Proficiency, the Royal College of Paramedics Curriculum and the Paramedic Apprenticeship Standard.

## Who it is for

- Student paramedics: revision, placement preparation, OSCE practice, A&P
- Newly qualified paramedics: scenario practice and building confidence
- Qualified paramedics: CPD certificates and reflections for HCPC registration renewal
- Anyone applying for paramedic jobs or university places: interview practice

## Pricing

- Free account: no credit card needed. Includes limited daily chats with Hollie, limited scenarios, the adult cardiac arrest simulator, the differentials tool, limited flash cards, the Readiness Score and the free Think Like a Paramedic ebook.
- Every new account gets 7 days of Pro free. It ends by itself; nothing to cancel.
- Paramind Pro: £4.99 a month, or £49.99 a year.
- Group discounts for universities, training providers and ambulance trusts: https://paramind.co.uk/contact.html

## Free, no sign-up

- [Readiness Score](https://paramind.co.uk/readiness.html): 20 timed questions across 6 clinical domains, instant score
- [Clue Hunt](https://paramind.co.uk/cluehunt-free.html): examine an illustrated patient and make your call
- [Think Like a Paramedic ebook](https://paramind.co.uk/index-free-paramedic-book.html): 25 clinical frameworks for thinking on scene
